title: TCS Flags Cautious Client Spending as Q1FY27 Revenue Growth Slows
content: Tata Consultancy Services reported softer-than-expected revenue growth for the June quarter, citing delayed decision-making by BFSI clients in North America amid macro uncertainty.

title: Infosys Raises FY27 Revenue Guidance on Strong Deal Wins
content: Infosys lifted its full-year revenue growth guidance after posting a large deal TCV of over $3 billion in Q1, led by demand for AI-led digital transformation services.

title: Wipro Wins Multi-Year IT Outsourcing Deal from European Insurer
content: Wipro announced a large-scale application modernization and cloud migration contract with a major European insurance group, expected to ramp up revenue from Q3.

title: HCLTech Q1 Profit Beats Estimates on Engineering Services Strength
content: HCLTech posted a better-than-expected quarterly profit, driven by robust growth in its engineering and R&D services segment even as software services remained muted.

title: Tech Mahindra Shares Slide After Weak Telecom Vertical Show
content: Tech Mahindra's stock fell over 4% after the company reported continued weakness in its communications vertical, its largest revenue contributor.

title: LTIMindtree Signs $150M AI Modernization Deal with US Retailer
content: LTIMindtree said it has bagged a multi-year agreement to overhaul a leading US retail chain's data and AI infrastructure, its largest deal signed this fiscal year.

title: Reliance Industries Jio Platforms Crosses 500 Million Subscriber Mark
content: Reliance Industries said its telecom arm Jio has crossed the 500-million subscriber milestone, aided by strong 5G adoption and rising data consumption across India.

title: Reliance Retail Plans Aggressive Store Expansion in Tier-2 Cities
content: Reliance Retail announced plans to open over 1,000 new outlets across smaller Indian cities this fiscal year as part of its omnichannel growth strategy.

title: ONGC Reports Higher Output as New Offshore Fields Ramp Up
content: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation reported a rise in crude output for the quarter as production from its KG basin deepwater fields continued to scale up.

title: BPCL Margins Squeezed by Volatile Crude Oil Prices
content: Bharat Petroleum Corporation reported thinner refining margins for the quarter, as elevated crude oil prices weighed on profitability despite steady fuel demand.

title: Coal India Output Rises as Monsoon Disruption Eases
content: Coal India reported a sequential improvement in production and dispatches after early monsoon rains had disrupted mining operations in eastern India.

title: HDFC Bank Q1 Net Profit Rises on Steady Loan Growth
content: HDFC Bank reported a rise in quarterly net profit, supported by healthy growth in retail and commercial loans, though deposit mobilisation remained a key focus area.

title: ICICI Bank Asset Quality Improves, Gross NPA Falls Below 2%
content: ICICI Bank reported an improvement in asset quality for the June quarter, with gross non-performing assets declining as recoveries outpaced fresh slippages.

title: SBI Plans Fresh Capital Raise to Support Credit Growth
content: State Bank of India's board approved plans to raise fresh equity capital during the fiscal year to support its growing loan book and maintain capital adequacy.

title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Shares Rise on Strong Deposit Growth
content: Kotak Mahindra Bank's stock gained after the lender reported robust growth in current and savings account deposits, easing concerns over funding costs.

title: Axis Bank Flags Elevated Provisions on Unsecured Loan Stress
content: Axis Bank reported higher provisions for the quarter due to continued stress in its unsecured retail loan portfolio, denting overall profitability.

title: IndusInd Bank Stock Rallies on Management Stability Signals
content: Shares of IndusInd Bank rose after the lender reaffirmed leadership continuity and outlined a roadmap to rebuild investor confidence following past governance concerns.

title: Bajaj Finance Q1 AUM Growth Beats Street Estimates
content: Bajaj Finance reported robust growth in assets under management for the June quarter, driven by strong demand across consumer durables and personal loan segments.

title: Bajaj Finserv Expands Insurance Distribution Network
content: Bajaj Finserv announced an expansion of its insurance distribution footprint into rural and semi-urban markets to widen its retail customer base.

title: Shriram Finance Reports Steady Growth in Vehicle Financing Book
content: Shriram Finance posted steady growth in its commercial vehicle financing portfolio, supported by resilient demand from the used-vehicle segment.

title: SBI Life Insurance New Business Premium Rises on Festive Demand
content: SBI Life Insurance reported healthy growth in new business premiums, aided by strong demand for protection and savings-linked policies ahead of the festive season.

title: HDFC Life Shares Gain on Improved Persistency Ratios
content: HDFC Life Insurance shares advanced after the company reported improved policy persistency ratios, indicating better customer retention across its product suite.

title: Hindustan Unilever Sees Rural Demand Recovery in Q1
content: Hindustan Unilever reported a pickup in rural volume growth for the June quarter, signalling a gradual recovery in consumption after several soft quarters.

title: ITC Cigarette Business Faces Pressure from Higher State Taxes
content: ITC's cigarette segment reported slower volume growth as several states raised local levies, adding to the tax burden on tobacco products.

title: Nestle India Launches New Range of Plant-Based Products
content: Nestle India unveiled a new range of plant-based food products aimed at health-conscious urban consumers as part of its premiumisation strategy.

title: Britannia Industries Raises Prices Amid Rising Input Costs
content: Britannia Industries announced modest price hikes across its biscuit portfolio to offset rising costs of wheat flour and edible oil.

title: Tata Consumer Products Expands Coffee Portfolio in Southern Markets
content: Tata Consumer Products announced the expansion of its coffee brands into new southern Indian markets, aiming to capture a larger share of the region's coffee-drinking base.

title: Larsen & Toubro Bags Large Infrastructure Order from Middle East
content: Larsen & Toubro announced it has secured a large engineering and construction order from a Middle Eastern client, boosting its order book for the year.

title: L&T Shares Rise on Strong Order Inflow Guidance
content: Larsen & Toubro shares gained after management reiterated confidence in double-digit order inflow growth for the current fiscal year, led by infrastructure and energy projects.

title: UltraTech Cement Reports Volume Growth Despite Monsoon Slowdown
content: UltraTech Cement posted modest volume growth for the quarter even as construction activity slowed in parts of the country due to heavy monsoon rains.

title: Grasim Industries Q1 Profit Rises on Strong Paints Business Ramp-up
content: Grasim Industries reported higher quarterly profit as its newly launched paints business gained market share faster than anticipated.

title: Adani Enterprises Shares Jump on New Green Hydrogen Investment Plan
content: Adani Enterprises announced a fresh investment plan to scale up its green hydrogen manufacturing capacity, sending its shares higher in early trade.

title: Adani Ports Reports Record Cargo Volumes at Mundra Terminal
content: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone reported record monthly cargo throughput at its flagship Mundra port, driven by higher container and dry bulk traffic.

title: Power Grid Corporation Wins Transmission Project via Tariff-Based Bidding
content: Power Grid Corporation of India said it has won a new interstate transmission project through competitive tariff-based bidding, adding to its regulated asset base.

title: NTPC Targets Higher Renewable Capacity Addition This Fiscal
content: NTPC said it plans to significantly ramp up renewable energy capacity additions this fiscal year as part of its long-term decarbonisation roadmap.

title: JSW Steel Reports Higher Output, Flags Global Price Pressure
content: JSW Steel reported higher quarterly output but flagged pressure on realisations due to soft global steel prices and rising imports from China.

title: Tata Steel Europe Operations Continue to Weigh on Consolidated Profit
content: Tata Steel's consolidated profit remained under pressure as its European operations continued to post losses amid weak regional demand.

title: Hindalco Industries Gains on Higher Aluminium Prices
content: Hindalco Industries shares advanced after global aluminium prices firmed up, supporting better realisations for the company's upstream business.

title: Maruti Suzuki Reports Strong SUV Sales in June Quarter
content: Maruti Suzuki India reported a rise in quarterly sales, led by robust demand for its SUV lineup and a recovery in rural bookings.

title: Tata Motors Commercial Vehicle Volumes Rebound in Q1
content: Tata Motors reported a rebound in commercial vehicle volumes for the June quarter, aided by improved fleet utilisation and infrastructure-led demand.

title: Mahindra & Mahindra Tractor Sales Rise on Good Monsoon Outlook
content: Mahindra & Mahindra reported higher tractor sales for the month, supported by an improved monsoon outlook and expectations of a strong rabi sowing season.

title: Bajaj Auto Shares Slip on Weak Domestic Two-Wheeler Demand
content: Bajaj Auto shares declined after the company reported softer-than-expected domestic two-wheeler sales for the quarter amid subdued entry-level demand.

title: Sun Pharma Gets USFDA Nod for New Speciality Drug
content: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries received US FDA approval for a new speciality dermatology drug, expected to strengthen its presence in the US market.

title: Dr Reddy's Labs Faces Pricing Pressure in US Generics Market
content: Dr Reddy's Laboratories flagged continued pricing pressure in the US generics business, even as its domestic formulations segment posted healthy growth.

title: Cipla Expands Respiratory Drug Portfolio in Emerging Markets
content: Cipla announced the launch of new respiratory therapy products across several emerging markets as part of its global expansion strategy.

title: Apollo Hospitals Reports Higher Occupancy Across Key Metros
content: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise reported improved bed occupancy rates across its metro hospitals, supported by rising demand for specialty and digital health services.

title: Asian Paints Loses Market Share Amid Rising Competition
content: Asian Paints reported a decline in market share for the quarter as new entrants intensified competition in the decorative paints segment.

title: Titan Company Jewellery Sales Surge on Wedding Season Demand
content: Titan Company reported strong growth in its jewellery division, led by robust wedding-season demand and rising gold prices boosting overall revenue.

title: Trent Shares Hit Record High on Zudio Store Expansion
content: Shares of Trent scaled a fresh record high after the retailer reported strong same-store sales growth and rapid expansion of its value-fashion brand Zudio.

title: Bharti Airtel Adds Postpaid Subscribers Amid 5G Push
content: Bharti Airtel reported strong postpaid subscriber additions during the quarter as its continued 5G network rollout helped drive premium customer growth.

title: RBI Holds Repo Rate at 5.25% for Third Straight Meeting
content: The Reserve Bank of India kept its key repo rate unchanged at 5.25% and maintained a neutral policy stance, citing a weakening rupee and supply-side inflation pressures.

title: RBI Trims FY27 GDP Growth Forecast to 6.6% Amid Global Headwinds
content: The Reserve Bank of India lowered its GDP growth projection for the current fiscal year, citing elevated oil prices and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East as key risks.

title: India's Retail Inflation Edges Higher on Food and Fuel Prices
content: India's headline consumer price inflation rose in June, driven by higher food and fuel costs, though core inflation remained largely stable, according to government data.

title: Government Weighs Further GST Rate Rationalisation for FMCG Goods
content: The finance ministry is reportedly evaluating a simplification of GST slabs for everyday consumer goods, a move that could reduce prices across the FMCG sector.

title: Crude Oil Prices Climb on Middle East Supply Concerns
content: Global crude oil prices rose for a third straight session as escalating tensions in the Middle East raised concerns over potential disruptions to regional supply.

title: Indian Rupee Slips to Fresh Low Against US Dollar
content: The Indian rupee weakened further against the US dollar, pressured by sustained foreign portfolio outflows and rising global crude oil prices.

title: India's Fiscal Deficit Narrows in First Quarter of FY27
content: India's fiscal deficit came in lower than the year-ago period for the April-June quarter, supported by strong direct tax collections and controlled capital spending.

title: Parliament Passes Amendments to Income Tax Bill
content: The Indian Parliament passed key amendments to the new Income Tax Bill, simplifying compliance norms for individual taxpayers and small businesses.

title: India-US Trade Deal Talks Resume Amid Tariff Uncertainty
content: Indian and US trade negotiators resumed talks this week aimed at finalising a bilateral trade agreement, as both sides work to resolve outstanding tariff disputes.

title: FIIs Turn Net Sellers in Indian Equities for Second Straight Month
content: Foreign institutional investors pulled out further capital from Indian equity markets in July, extending outflows amid a stronger dollar and elevated global bond yields.

title: India's Manufacturing PMI Slips to Six-Month Low
content: India's manufacturing purchasing managers' index eased to a six-month low in June, as new export orders softened amid global trade uncertainty.

title: Union Cabinet Approves New Infrastructure Investment Push
content: The Union Cabinet approved a fresh round of infrastructure spending focused on roads, railways and port connectivity as part of the government's capex-led growth strategy.

title: India Wins T20 Series Decider Against Sri Lanka in Thriller
content: India clinched the final T20 international against Sri Lanka by five wickets in a last-over thriller, sealing the series 3-2 in Colombo.

title: Bollywood Star's Upcoming Film Trailer Breaks YouTube Records
content: The trailer for a much-anticipated Bollywood action film crossed 50 million views within 24 hours of its release, setting a new record for the year.

title: Heavy Rainfall Predicted Across Western Coastal States This Week
content: The India Meteorological Department has issued an orange alert for several western coastal states, forecasting heavy to very heavy rainfall over the next four days.

title: Local Civic Body Launches New Waste Management Drive
content: A city municipal corporation announced a new door-to-door waste segregation initiative aimed at improving recycling rates across residential neighbourhoods.

title: Popular Food Delivery App Introduces New Loyalty Rewards Program
content: A leading food delivery platform launched a revamped loyalty rewards program offering discounts and priority delivery slots for frequent users.

title: Wimbledon Champion Announces Charity Foundation Launch
content: This year's Wimbledon singles champion announced the launch of a new charitable foundation focused on providing sports scholarships to underprivileged children.

title: New Web Series Tops Streaming Charts in Opening Weekend
content: A newly released web series topped regional streaming charts in its opening weekend, drawing praise from critics for its writing and performances.

title: City Traffic Police Roll Out New Smart Signal System
content: The city traffic police department began rolling out AI-based smart traffic signals at major intersections, aiming to reduce peak-hour congestion.
